generator_cmd: printf %s 'the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog' | iconv -f utf-8 -t UTF-32BE | xxd -p | tr -d '\n'  # PLAIN big-endian UTF-32, not middle-endian
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | xxd -r -p | iconv -f UTF-32BE -t utf-8  # reads directly: the unicode-form codecs own it, the PDP decoder must decline
oracle_plain: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
